ABOUT PINOY BALL · MANILA, PHILIPPINES

Independent NBA Matchup Analysis Built for Filipino Basketball Fans

Pinoy Ball is an independent sports analysis publication dedicated to clear, evidence-backed 2026–2027 NBA matchup predictions and Philippine Standard Time (PHT / UTC+8) schedules.

Why We Built Pinoy Ball

Basketball is woven into everyday life in the Philippines, yet most NBA preview sites publish schedules in US Eastern Time, hide losing picks, or rely on automated filler text. Pinoy Ball was created in Manila to give Filipino basketball readers a clean, fast, human-written resource where every tip-off is reported in Philippine Standard Time and every pick shows its basketball reasoning.

Editorial Transparency & Accountability

Every matchup preview published on Pinoy Ball is authored manually by our editorial desk following our six-pillar analytical methodology. We never auto-generate picks, never delete unsuccessful calls, and permanently grade every completed game inside our public Prediction Results Archive.

Informational Purpose

Pinoy Ball is strictly an independent basketball analysis and sports information publication—not a sportsbook, gambling operator, or wagering platform. All matchup analysis is provided free of charge for informational and educational basketball discussion.

PINOY BALL Independent thinking. Basketball first.
